Name: Bigger Greenhouse For Iridium Sprinklers
Author: Cylesburk
Description:
This edit allows for exact placements of Iridium Sprinklers and houses 2 water troughs. Unfortunately. This mod requires replanting of crops inside the greenhouse. I highly recommend harvesting whatever crops you can (if ancient fruit, use a seed maker to replace the plants your losing) before installing this mod. 

And as always, backup your original greenhouse.xnb located in your Steam Games\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps folder should you decide to return to a smaller greenhouse.

I have created a workaround for the warping issue, you will now warp into a small "Foyer" for lack of a better word, which you then proceed to the main area. I hope this doesn't inconvenience anyone too much and that my mod is still worth downloading.

I'm still learning so if you see anything wrong, let me know. Thanks :D. If anyone has a detailed understanding of Paths.xnb and how to apply certain things (For example Hardwood Tree Stump additions for larger Woods area mod) and wouldn't mind sharing their knowledge on the subject. That would be greatly appreciated.

Also taking suggestions for future mods.

Downloads.Description: This update fixes the trough issue. They now supply water as intended.
